AwesomeMath Summer Program

entry.title: The AMR invites submissions for the Paper of the Future Prize
entry.content:
The AMR invites submissions for the Paper of the Future Prize

Prizes or Awards / Graduate students, Postdocs/early career, Mathematical scientists/faculty
We seek submissions that demonstrate communicative capabilities fundamentally unavailable in a static PDF. Each submission must explicitly articulate what essential communicative function it provides that a linear paper cannot. The initiative is intended as an experiment in format innovation, not as a replacement for traditional scholarship. The prize includes a cash award of $10,000. Submissions are due September 1, 2026. entry.content:
The AMR invites nominations for the Fred R. Cohen Prize

Prizes or Awards / Postdocs/early career, Mathematical scientists/faculty
This prize honors the work of Fred R. Cohen, who made fundamental advances in a range of fields. The award is granted every other year to a person who has made outstanding contributions in the fields of algebraic topology and homotopy theory. Candidates from anywhere in the world are equally considered. The prize includes a cash award of $5,000. Nominations are due September 30, 2026.
